name: Neon Nights Pt. 777
description: Neon Nights Pt. 777 is That Boy Hi Hat gliding through his futuristic lane, a synthwave-leaning alternative rap record that the 2026-09-17 analysis notes flagged as a sync-ready signal. The production is electronic and ethereal, synth pads and arps drifting throughout over halftime drums with 808 bass pulsing underneath the verses. That Boy Hi Hat's delivery is smooth and hypnotic, his vocals riding the groove with a late-night ease that turns seductive when the chorus blooms. The mix is polished and cinematic, reverb-heavy with a widescreen sound, a dreamy nocturnal record that feels like driving through a city that never sleeps. It sounds like the night-shift twin of his darker singles, recalling the glow of synth-driven electronic rap in the vein of the post-trap futurism wave. For fans of chill rap and melodic trap, Neon Nights Pt. 777 evokes neon reflections, futuristic, mysterious, and laid-back. The record has lived on YouTube Topic since December 2022, quietly gathering plays and proving its staying power in the catalog. It sits alongside the strongest sync-ready material in the CWI catalog, in conversation with the futuristic records that define That Boy Hi Hat's current era. Synthesizer, keys, hi-hats, and atmospheric pads fill the frame with patient, cinematic restraint.
